title: Reliance Points for a Long Overpaid Period — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Waiver Schedule
content:
Reliance over a long overpaid period adds points to the waiver share on Benefit Overpayment Accounts. The overpaid period is counted in weeks from the first to the last overpaid week inclusive.

| Overpaid period | Points added to the waiver share |
|---|---|
| 16 weeks or more (the long-period weeks) | 0.15, the long-period points |
| 8 weeks or more but fewer than 16 (the mid-period weeks) | 0.1, the mid-period points |
| Fewer than 8 weeks | None |

## Counting the weeks

The first and last overpaid weeks are read from the overpayment record by their week ending dates. The number of weeks is the calendar days from the first overpaid week's ending date to the last overpaid week's ending date, divided by seven, plus one for the first week.

## Hypothetical cases

| First overpaid week ending | Last overpaid week ending | Days between | Weeks | Points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 January 2026 | 18 April 2026 | 105 | 16 | 0.15 |
| 3 January 2026 | 11 April 2026 | 98 | 15 | 0.1 |
| 3 January 2026 | 21 February 2026 | 49 | 8 | 0.1 |
| 3 January 2026 | 14 February 2026 | 42 | 7 | None |
